reviewer_note: qty__btn is 40x40px inside a system whose --touch token is 72px and whose README promises a 72px minimum target; the two buttons are stacked vertically with a 12px gap either side of no label, glyphs are 24px (body is 28px), there is no live announcement of the changing count, and disabled-at-bounds state is conveyed only by opacity 0.4 (btn rule does not even apply — .qty__btn has no .btn class, so disabled has NO visual treatment at all). Expected fix: size the steppers to >= --touch (ideally larger for older users), lay them out horizontally flanking the value, give real accessible names, announce the value, and give a visible disabled state. Must not touch idle timeout or i18n strings.
